tasks.description: Implement a comprehensive vehicle filtering system for the Trailblaze Auto catalogue, including multi-dimensional filters for condition, brand, body style, fuel type, transmission, and price range with a clean reset mechanism.
acceptance_criteria: The Condition filter using data-testid='condition-filter-New' must correctly show only 'Brand New' vehicles.
The Condition filter using data-testid='condition-filter-Pre-Owned' must correctly show only 'Pre-Owned' vehicles.
The Brand dropdown filter with data-testid='brand-filter' must correctly show only vehicles of the selected brand.
The Body Style dropdown filter with data-testid='body-type-filter' must correctly show only vehicles of the selected body type.
Fuel Type toggle pills with data-testid='fuel-filter-[Type]' (e.g., Electric) must correctly filter the inventory.
Transmission toggle pills with data-testid='transmission-filter-[Type]' (e.g., Automatic) must correctly filter results.
The Budget Range filter with data-testid='price-filter-[Range]' (e.g., Under 5L) must correctly filter vehicles within the selected price brackets.
Combining multiple active filters (e.g., Brand + Fuel Type) must narrow results correctly based on all active criteria.
Selecting conflicting filter combinations that have no overlap must gracefully show the 'No matches found' state (Negative Case).
Selecting a brand that has no available inventory for the current criteria must display the 'No matches found' message (Negative Case).
Selecting a budget range with no available vehicles must result in the 'No matches found' heading being visible (Negative Case).
The filtering system must correctly exclude vehicles marked as 'Sold', ensuring they never appear in filtered results (Negative Case).
The 'Clear All Filters' button with data-testid='reset-filters' must clear all active selections and restore the full available catalogue.
